prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one landscape 3:2 graphic-novel panel, ideally 1536x1024. Refine the supplied flat storyboard into mature hand-inked investigative comic art: heavy brush and nib blacks, dry-brush abrasion, subtle halftone, dirty paper grain, plausible perspective, matte ordinary materials. Preserve subject placement and negative space. Reference is composition blocking, not the desired flat-vector finish. Remove the outer frame/broken border; production adds borders and lettering separately. Edge-to-edge single scene, no page layout, captions, balloons, slates, watermarks, logos or invented glyphs. Draw only the explicitly requested labels exactly; never copy the board's horizontal placeholder strokes as fake words. Dominant charcoal #101214 and #202326 with paper #E7E0D0 and muted steel #5E737B. No neon, glow, dramatic hero lighting, glossy render or embodied software.

Windowless evaluation data-center aisle, concrete floor, plausible matte racks and overhead cable trays. Match board placement: dim racks left and far right, single highlighted rack just left of center. Keep upper-left 40% width/25% height quiet dark for later caption. Small task card upper-right, headed exactly PHASEONE10841; its remaining body uses only two simple highlighted neutral blocks without words or technical detail. No people. Steel practical light, almost entirely black. No moss, claret or amber. Keep detail in shadows.
controls: Tool did not expose model revision, seed, sampler, strength, or billing. PNG output requested at 3:2; actual dimensions measured on import.
